notes:
Find in page with Ctrl+F, and downloads now show real progress.

Back and forward go through the browser's own history, so a page comes back from
cache with its scroll position instead of being fetched again. Open tabs are
restored when you relaunch.

New in this release: private tabs, clear site data, print, fullscreen, a home
button, a zoom indicator, pinned tabs, a tab context menu, and a bookmarks bar
on Ctrl+Shift+B. The icon set has been redrawn.

Fixed: opening a new tab or searching while Settings or History was open left
the new page hidden behind the panel.
